methods: SHA-256 comparison across all 21 originals, the manifest, the retrieval log and every previously published site asset
MiEnviro metadata comparison using document IDs, titles, dates, byte counts, hashes, parent events and related-record notes
PDF magic-byte validation, page counts, metadata and normalized extracted-text comparison
Rendered visual review of every image-only compliance page, all six map sheets and all 30 lagoon analytical/QA pages
Draft-versus-final permit comparison by page structure, authorization dates, limits, conditions and attachments
Provenance separation: the retrieval log records acquisition status but does not substitute for an unavailable original record

decisions.name: 2015-2016_Wexford County Landfill_Leachate Request.pdf

decisions.name: GW Public Notice Document.html
decisions.reason: Not republished because it exactly matches Category 02 record 076. Magic-byte and PDF-parser checks show that the .html-named source actually contains a valid one-page PDF payload.

decisions.name: Construction Permit 4127 · Wexford-County-Landfill.pdf
decisions.reason: Not republished because it exactly matches Category 02 record 039. The 2024 Operating License 9758 has the same base filename but a different hash, date, page count and legal purpose, so it was retained.

decisions.name: lagoon summary.pdf
decisions.reason: Retained once. Two MiEnviro document IDs in the manifest resolve to the same relative path, byte count and SHA-256 hash; the disk set already contains only one copy.

decisions.name: Rule 2210 draft and final authorization
decisions.reason: Both retained. The draft is 20 pages; the final is 26 pages and adds an issued/effective/expiration clock, final limits and attachments. They are not duplicates.

decisions.name: Misnamed .docx and .html sources
decisions.reason: The two .docx-named records and the .html-named public notice begin with a PDF header and parse as PDFs. Original display names are preserved for provenance; delivery uses the correct .pdf media extension.

decisions.name: Scan-only records
decisions.reason: The compliance scan, six map sheets and 30-page lagoon package were rendered and reviewed page by page. They contain distinct substantive content and were not suppressed.

decisions.name: Private preservation delivery
decisions.reason: The 19 new records are preserved at immutable GitHub commit 1f44c9e90e718f6e130bdfc319be48098d2163e5 in the authorized private repository. Source files on F: were read only and were not renamed, moved or altered.
